description:
Depends on opi-gfy.3 (Interactive as GenServer).

build_ui_context/1 (interactive.ex:130-211) manually reimplements GenServer.call for synchronous UI requests:

  ref = make_ref()
  send(interactive_pid, {:ui_request, self(), ref, msg})
  receive do
    {:ui_reply, ^ref, value} -> value
  after 5_000 -> raise ...
  end

With Interactive as a GenServer this becomes:
  GenServer.call(interactive_pid, {:ui_request, msg}, 5_000)

And handle_call({:ui_request, msg}, from, state) either:
  - replies immediately for fire-and-forget ops
  - stores from in state.dialog and calls GenServer.reply(from, value) when the user acts (for select/confirm/input/editor)

Eliminates: make_ref/0, the manual ref tuple in dialog state, send({:ui_reply, ref, value}) in handle_ui_request, and the separate :ui_fire path (becomes cast).
title: UIContext: replace manual ref/send/receive with GenServer.call
